purpose: Exact artifact identities consumed by authorize_closed_loop.py. These are evidence contracts, not permission to change CSTAR scientific formulas.

pass_requirements: source proper score and localization error improve over a matched unconstrained temporal encoder on controlled held-out data
same exact source under distinct transport/release/sensor nuisance interventions moves zS less than the unconstrained encoder
source-label permutation removes the task gain
removing the intervention constraint measurably worsens invariance
candidate search domain is independent of evaluator source truth
leave-one-House-out direction is reported and is not carried by only one House
training/evaluation contain multiple source hypotheses/placements rather than only the three historical House truths
held-out first-passage NLL and Brier improve over the frozen causal plume/FOPDT baseline and the uncorrected physics prior
encounter CDF / route committor are calibrated on held-out transport realizations
future wind/gas are never model inputs
held-out predictive bank is never queried by the deployable provider
same decision context has at least two feasible route interventions
realized route outcomes are independent evaluator outcomes and were not used to construct route_laws
native PMFS route is included whenever feasible
PHS improves realized source risk relative to native route
deterministic route-law shuffle degrades/removes the gain

MODELS.hard_rule: Checkpoints are frozen before closed-loop outcomes and are loaded without online fitting or House-specific adaptation.

hard_rules: mode must be isolated cstar_v1; legacy CPIR/CTPI formulas remain reproducible
runtime reads no source truth, House ID, future gas/wind, simulator member identity, or deployment predictive bank
models are loaded once from frozen hashes
real navigation path is used when available; otherwise a preregistered endpoint+dwell fallback is used; no fake straight line through obstacles
invalid/timeout inference fails closed to native PMFS and logs the fallback

SMOKE.hard_rule: Smoke validates wiring/timing/legality only. It is not a scientific performance PASS.
